reasons.log: Keep engine receipts under this checkout.
reasons.tokenizer: Tokenizer shipped with the same model weights.
reasons.model_name: Stable API model identifier for existing clients.
reasons.host: Bind locally; expose only through an explicitly configured proxy.
reasons.prefix_replay: Reuse a verified prefix on resumed requests.
reasons.sampling: The selected server defaults, overridden by explicit request parameters.
reasons.tool_call_recovery: Repair truncated tool-call forms before returning them.
reasons.args: Selected model inputs and bounded decode/cache policy; model paths are relative to this checkout. No zero-valued off switches.
reasons.env.D7_BIN: Built engine binary, not a lab artifact.
reasons.env.REA_PREFILL_FATBIN: Device prefill planner built with the engine.
reasons.env.REA_PREFILL_SHIM: Same Mac CUDA shim as the engine.
reasons.env.STRATA_EXL3_METAL_LIB: Metal exchange lane built from this source.
reasons.env.STRATA_EXL3_METAL_SLOTS: Allow 77 RAM-tier copies and the prompt-loan experts after the upstream cache shrank to 8112 slots; 19300 left 35 missing.
reasons.env.STRATA_XCH: Use the selected GPU/Metal exchange path.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_SM: Fallback device architecture: the shim reads the installed card's compute capability first.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_SMS: Fallback multiprocessor count: the shim reads the installed card's SM count first.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_MEM_GIB: Fallback device memory size: the shim reads the installed card's physical pool first.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_L2_MIB: Fallback cache size: the backend does not report an L2 size, so this value stands.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_BUSW: Fallback bus width: the backend does not report one, so this value stands.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_CLOCK_MHZ: Fallback clock rate in MHz (the RTX 5090's 2407 MHz boost clock): the backend does not report one, so this value stands, and the layer split reads it through cudaDevAttrClockRate.
reasons.env.TGCU_DEV_NAME: Fallback GPU name: the backend does not report one, so device properties show this, not a detection.

reasons.args.--pack: Expert pack, tokenizer and quantization layout used by selected model.
reasons.args.--native: Dense weights for the selected model.
reasons.args.--native-dense-gguf: Reuse the dense GGUF for native projection matrices.
reasons.args.--ple-gguf: NVFP4 prefill lookup table from the same weights.
reasons.args.--mtp: Selected draft-layer weights for verified speculation.
reasons.args.--expert-profile: Ranked expert residency, shipped with this checkout.
reasons.args.--expert-cache: Size the card cache after accounting for other resident weights.
reasons.args.--prefill: Bound prompt processing chunks to the selected 10240-token policy.
reasons.args.--spec: At most four verifier tokens per speculative window.
reasons.args.--kv: Use int8 KV cache to leave card memory for expert residency.
reasons.args.--resident-budget-gib: Bound the locked RAM expert tier.
reasons.args.--vram-reserve-mib: Leave 630 MiB for graph capture and other runtime allocation.
reasons.args.--conversation-cache-mib: Cap GPU cache for resumed conversations.
reasons.args.--conversation-cache-min-free-mib: Keep free VRAM before admitting a parked conversation.
reasons.args.--mmap-experts: Map on-disk experts for the selected file-tier policy.
reasons.args.--prompt-cache-every: Checkpoint long prompt reads every 2048 tokens.
reasons.args.--prompt-cache: Bound prompt checkpoints on the engine.
reasons.args.--pcie-frac: Keep the selected PCIe expert tier disabled; upstream auto-selects a nonzero share if absent.
reasons.args.--adapt-every: Keep adaptive swaps disabled; upstream defaults to periodic adaptation if absent.
reasons.args.--suffix-draft: Keep suffix drafting disabled; upstream enables it if absent.
